_note: Sample trail segments. Geometry is APPROXIMATE (hand-drawn), to be replaced by K4's surveyed GPX. Each segment records the village it starts in and every village it connects.

segments.description_local: Pješačka staza od obale u Donjoj Lastvi uzbrdo do Gornje Lastve. Kaldrma i zemljani put kroz maslinjake. Trag je približan.
segments.description_en: Footpath from the shore in Donja Lastva uphill to Gornja Lastva. Cobbled and dirt path through olive groves. Track is approximate.
segments.source: sample GPX drawn from public map data — approximate, to be replaced by surveyed track (K4)

segments.description_local: Uspon od sela do crkve Svetog Vida na 440 m. Trag je približan.
